---
title: "JL_BRMS_models_v4"
author: "Jet Lambers, but mainly Upasana Shah (and Marwan Engels)"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
params:
 render_title: "SSRI study models" # default title; can be adjusted to "adaptive" "perseverative" "all"
 group: "all" # default group; can be "adaptive", "perseverative", "all"
 computer: "VNC" # default on laptop; can be "VNC" or "laptop"
 models2run: 7 # default brms model to run
 family: "bernoulli" # Define what type of model to run: "bernoulli" or "gaussian" 
output: html_document
---

This is Jet's adaptation of Upasana's script defining statistical Bayesian models. 
Update 11/3/2026: This script includes all behavioral measures
Update 13/2/2026: Models include group
Update 16/3/2026: Models about differences post-treatment ses from baseline
Update 18/3/2026: Models include a covariate of baseline performance/behavior

Update 7/5/2026: Models include Trait Anxiety covariate

# Load libraries and data, set contrasts, define directories
```{r Settings}
#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
cat("start\n")

# Load packages:
cat("load libraries\n")
library(tidyverse)   # data managing
library(tidyr)     # data handling
library(broom.mixed)  # convert brms summary to excel table
library(dplyr)     # data managing
library(ggplot2)    # plotting
library(brms)      # bayesian models
library(performance)  # check model assumptions
library(rstan)
library(openxlsx)   # export to excel


# Set directories
if(.Platform$OS.type == "unix"){dirs = '/project/2424182.03/'} else {dirs = 'P://2424182.03/'}
data_dir <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Dataframes")
out_dir <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Output_other")
out_dir_plots <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Plots")
out_dir_models <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Models")
out_dir_excel <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Excel")
out_dir_stats <- file.path(dirs, "analysis/robot_task/jet/Statistics/Stats")

# Penalize scientific notation
cat("load settings\n")
options(scipen = 20) # no scientific notation

# Setup rstan params
cat("setup cluster processing\n")
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
set.seed(444) # to make it reproducible every time
```

# Initialize dataframe
```{r Initialize dataframe}
# Load data
cat("load data\n")

# Depending on JL or US dataframe load different file
# file_name <- "SSRI_full_brms_data.csv"  # US
file_name <- "BMRS_input_analysis_df_full.csv"    # JL
df_task <-read.csv(file.path(data_dir, file_name)) # load in full data set

# Prepare and clean data
cat("as.factors\n")
#make categorical vars factor vars

#df_task$subject <- as.factor(df_task$participant)  # change to subject or participant depending on JL or US 
df_task$action_valence_num <- dplyr::recode(
  df_task$condition_type,
  "Go to win" = 4,
  "Go to avoid loss" = 3,
  "No go to win" = 2,
  "No go to avoid loss" = 1
)

df_task$action_valence_c <- as.numeric(scale(
  df_task$action_valence_num,
  center = TRUE,
  scale = FALSE
))

df_task$action_valence_c <- as.factor(df_task$action_valence_c)
df_task$subject <- factor(df_task$subject)
df_task$session <- factor(df_task$session)
df_task$miniblock <- factor(df_task$miniblock)
df_task$controllability_brms <- factor(df_task$controllability_brms, levels = c(1, -1))
df_task$trial_valence <- factor(df_task$trial_valence, levels = c(1, -1))
df_task$required_action <- factor(df_task$required_action, levels = c(1, -1))
df_task$key_response <- factor(df_task$key_response, levels = c(1, 0))
df_task$prev_action <- factor(df_task$prev_action, levels = c(1, -1))
df_task$prev_outcome <- factor(df_task$prev_outcome, levels = c(1, -1))
df_task$group <- factor(df_task$group, levels = c(1, -1))
df_task$learner <- factor(df_task$learner, levels = c(1, -1))

# Coding of correct response / accuracy depends on JL or US
df_task$right_response <- factor(df_task$right_response, levels = c(1, 0))
# df_task$right_response <- df_task$right_response <- factor(df_task$key_resp.corr, levels = c(1, 0)) 


# Set contrasts to sum-to-zero coding
cat("Set contrasts to sum-to-zero coding\n")
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

# Reset levels of factors
df_task$action_valence_c <- relevel(df_task$action_valence_c, ref = "1.5") # go to win
df_task$session <- relevel(df_task$session, ref = "1") # session 1
df_task$controllability_brms <- relevel(df_task$controllability_brms, ref = "1") # high control
df_task$trial_valence <- relevel(df_task$trial_valence, ref = "1") # reward valence
df_task$required_action <- relevel(df_task$required_action, ref = "1") # Go
df_task$key_response <- relevel(df_task$key_response, ref = "1") # Go
df_task$prev_action <- relevel(df_task$prev_action, ref = "1") # Go
df_task$prev_outcome <- relevel(df_task$prev_outcome, ref = "1") # reward
df_task$right_response <- relevel(df_task$right_response, ref = "1") # correct
df_task$group <- relevel(df_task$group, ref = "1")
 

# RTs are already log transformed in the dataframe

# Check contrast coding
contrasts(df_task$session) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_task$controllability_brms) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_task$trial_valence) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_task$required_action) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_task$prev_action) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_task$prev_outcome) <- contr.sum(2) 
contrasts(df_task$right_response) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_task$key_response) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_task$group) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_task$action_valence_c) <- contr.sum(4)



contrasts(df_task$session)
contrasts(df_task$miniblock)
contrasts(df_task$controllability_brms)
contrasts(df_task$trial_valence)
contrasts(df_task$required_action)
contrasts(df_task$prev_action)
contrasts(df_task$prev_outcome)
contrasts(df_task$right_response)
contrasts(df_task$key_response)
contrasts(df_task$group)
contrasts(df_task$action_valence_c)

df_task$control_block <- factor(df_task$control_block)
contrasts(df_task$control_block) <- contr.sum(4)
```

# Split data into different dataframes
```{r Split data}

df_task <- df_task %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(
    stai_t = ifelse(
      stai_t > mean(stai_t, na.rm = TRUE) + 2 * sd(stai_t, na.rm = TRUE) |
      stai_t < mean(stai_t, na.rm = TRUE) - 2 * sd(stai_t, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_,
      stai_t
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# session
df_task_full <- df_task
df_task_s1 <- filter(df_task, session == "1")
df_task <- filter(df_task, session == "2")

df_task_block <- df_task %>%
  group_by(subject, group, control_block) %>%
  summarise(
    controllability_brms = first(controllability_brms),
    reward_rate_s1 = first(reward_rate_s1),
    control_s1 = first(control_s1),
    control_rating = first(control_rating),
    reward_rate_c = mean(reward_rate, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(reward_rate_c = as.numeric(scale(reward_rate_c)))

# controllability
df_task_hc <- filter(df_task, controllability_brms == "1") # High Control
df_task_lc <- filter(df_task, controllability_brms == "-1") # Low Control

df_task_A <- filter(df_task, group == "1") # Group A
df_task_B <- filter(df_task, group == "-1") # Group B

df_task_go <- filter(df_task, required_action == "1")  # Go action
df_task_noGo <- filter(df_task, required_action == "-1") # No go action

df_task_pos <- filter(df_task, prev_outcome == "1") # Postive previous outcome
df_task_neg <- filter(df_task, prev_outcome == "-1") # negative previous outcome


# create list of dataframes for models
dataframes <- list(df_task,          #1 Data per block for subjective control 
          df_task_block,                         #2 s2 data no rep pGo
          df_task_s1,                      #3 Go data
          df_task_s1,                    #4 No-Go data
          df_task_hc,                      #5 High Control data
          df_task_lc,                      #6 Low Control data
          df_task,                         #7 s2 data (for acc) -> correct baseline
          df_task,                         #8 s2 data -> no ranef rep
          df_task,                         #9 s2 data no rep acc
          df_task_go,                      #10 Go data
          df_task_noGo,                    #11 No go data
          df_task_hc,                      #12 High control data
          df_task_lc,                      #13 lc_data
          df_task,                         #14 s2 data (RT) -> no ranef rep
          df_task,                         #15 s2 data no rep RT 
          df_task_s1,                      #16 s1 data for stai
          df_task,                         #17 s2 data for learner
          df_task,                      #18 s2 data (for WSLS)
          df_task_pos,                     #19 s2 data 
          df_task_neg,                     #20 s2 data
          df_task_A,                       #21 Group A data
          df_task_B                        #22 Group B data
)

str(df_task)
```


# Define models
```{r Defining models}

model_lists <- c(# pGo
         "key_response ~ group * controllability_brms * required_action * trial_valence * robot_repetition_z + pGo_s1 + stai_t (1 + controllability_brms * required_action * trial_valence * # robot_repetition_z | subject)" , #1
         # "control_rating ~ group * controllability_brms * reward_rate_c + control_s1 + reward_rate_s1 + (1 + controllability_brms * reward_rate_c | subject)",  #1
         
         "control_rating ~ group * control_block * reward_rate_c + control_s1 + reward_rate_s1 + (1 + control_block * reward_rate_c | subject)" , #2
         
         "key_response ~ stai_t * controllability_brms * trial_valence * robot_repetition_z + pGo_s1 + (1 + stai_t * controllability_brms * trial_valence * robot_repetition_z | subject)" , #3

         # Accuracy
```

# Run models 
```{r Running models}

cat("model BRMS\n")

model2run <- params$models2run

model_list <- model_lists[model2run]
model_name <- model_names[model2run]
model_distribution <- model_distributions[model2run]

data <- dataframes[[model2run]]

cat("model BRMS\n")
cat("Running bernoulli BRMS for model ", model_list, ":", model_name, "\n")

#run mixed effect model

model = brms::brm(model_list,
            data = data,
            family = model_distribution,
            warmup = 8000,
            iter = 10000,
            #threads = threading(2),
            chains = 4,
            cores = 1,
            save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE)
            )

cat("exporting\n")
# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
if(!dir.exists(out_dir_stats)){
 dir.create(out_dir_stats, recursive = TRUE)
}
model_output_path <- file.path(out_dir_stats, paste0("BRMS_", model_name, "_", model_distribution, ".rds"))
print(model_output_path)
saveRDS(model,file=model_output_path)


```

# Model stats
```{r Model stats}

# Model stats
model_summary <- summary(model)
model_posteriors <- posterior_summary(model)
model_tidy <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)

# If model performance crashes
model_perf <- tryCatch(
  {
    performance::model_performance(model)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    cat("model_performance failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    NULL  # return NULL so the rest of the script can check for it
  }
)

```

# Save model as excel/csv

```{r Exporting model as csv}

# Save model summary as csv
excel_workbook <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(excel_workbook, "Model_Summary")
summary_df <- as.data.frame(model_summary$fixed)
writeData(excel_workbook, "Model_Summary", summary_df, rowNames = TRUE)

# Add posterior summary
addWorksheet(excel_workbook, "Posterior_Summary")
post_df <- as.data.frame(model_posteriors)
writeData(excel_workbook, "Posterior_Summary", post_df, rowNames = TRUE)

# Add model performance
if (!is.null(model_perf)) {
  addWorksheet(excel_workbook, "Model_Performance")
  perf_df <- as.data.frame(model_perf)
  writeData(excel_workbook, "Model_Performance", perf_df, rowNames = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("Skipping Model_Performance sheet — model_performance returned NULL\n")
}

# Add tidy summary
addWorksheet(excel_workbook, "Tidy_Summary")
writeData(excel_workbook, "Tidy_Summary", model_tidy)

# Save workbook
model_excel_output_path <- file.path(out_dir_excel, paste0("BRMS_", model_name, "_", model_distribution, ".xlsx"))
saveWorkbook(excel_workbook, model_excel_output_path, overwrite = TRUE)

cat("saved workbook\n")

```

# Model checks

```{r Model checking}

# Number of iterations actually stored
posterior::niterations(model)
# Any divergent transitions or failed chains?
rstan::check_hmc_diagnostics(model$fit)

# Plot model checks
bayesplot::pp_check(model, type = "scatter", ndraws = 100)

# Plot posterior predictive checks
brms::pp_check(model, type = "hist", ndraws = 100)
brms::pp_check(model, type = "boxplot", ndraws = 100)

# Plot diagnostic plots
plot(model)

# Plot binomial distribution specific checks
brms::pp_check(model)

cat("succesfully performed model checks\n")

```
